newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 25.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Workers' unions and left-wing politicians support strike of truck drivers while negotiations with employers broke off in stalemate Monday morning.
-- Thomson-CSF defence group considers cutting up to 5,000 jobs through end 1997 because of cuts in military orders linked to a defence sector restructuring.

-- Jean-Francois Dehecq, chairman of Elf Aquitaine subsidiary Sanofi, says in an interview that Sanofi is about to launch three new drugs and intends to take part in the pharmaceutical sector restructuring in the next few years.
-- Last week's fire in Channel tunnel may jeopardise the extension of the tunnel's concession, called for by shareholders.
-- French train operator SNCF may sue Eurotunnel for failing to provide access to tunnel facilities.
-- Rhone-Poulenc increases to 28.4 percent its stake in family-owned pharmaceuticals group CFPI.
